convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load external 'Super_Trend' custom indicator, and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all position open/close logic and money management

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of the indicator timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: When BuyPosClose and SellPosClose are both enabled and neither BUY_Close nor SELL_Close was set by signal buffers, the EA scans forward from SignalBar+1 through all bars looking for the opposite Super_Trend band (buffer 0 for Up/trend, buffer 1 for Dn/trend) to set close signals retroactively

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT (value 4) means fixed lot size equal to MM input; other modes use MM as a percentage/fraction of free margin, balance, or loss-adjusted margin as defined in TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: The Super_Trend custom indicator has at least 4 buffers: buffer 0=Up trend line, buffer 1=Dn trend line, buffer 2=Up signal (non-empty=buy signal on that bar), buffer 3=Dn signal (non-empty=sell signal on that bar). Signal is read from bar index SignalBar+1 (default bar 2, i.e. 2 bars back from current). When both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are enabled but no close signal was generated directly, the EA performs a forward scan through historical bars to find the opposing trend band and set the close signal. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans act as feature toggles to enable/disable each direction and side. Signal times (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are computed as last bar date + TimeShiftSec and passed to position open functions for potential pending order logic inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of Super_Trend custom indicator logic (CCI-based with level threshold) since it is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The Super_Trend indicator source must be obtained to replicate buffer 0-3 behavior. TradeAlgorithms.mqh must also be analyzed to replicate BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, and GlobalVariableDel_ functions. The money management logic (MarginMode enum) is entirely encapsulated in the library. The retroactive close-signal scan (lines 119-145) is unusual and must be carefully ported. SL/TP of 1000/2000 pips are very large and likely assume 5-digit pricing (100.0/200.0 pips real); verify digit adjustment behavior in the library.
